chapter: Tenor players, tours and band boys
title: 1974 England tour with Warren Covington and Sy Oliver
summary: He toured England with Warren Covington's Tommy Dorsey band, with Sy Oliver conducting the second half.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Can you elaborate on that a little more, Panama? Because it's been so interesting so far. Let me see, you mentioned all of these different hit songs. You mentioned Fabian and Della Reese and Sarah Vaughn, you mentioned all of them, didn't you?
Yes, I did. Yeah. Although some of them I forgot.
Well, here in 1974, who was that now?

Well, in 1974 I toured England, with Warren Covington playing the music with Tommy Dorsey. And we also had Sy Oliver with him, because you know, Sy Oliver was the arranger for that. So the first segment of the show was the things that Tommy did before Sy Oliver started writing for the band, and then the second part, Sy was the conductor, and he did all of these things like ...
